```{r}
df_filter <- readRDS("shared_df_filter.rds")
```

```{r}
ckd_data <- df_filter %>%
  mutate(
    beer = factor(
      as.character(low_alcohol_beer) == "1" |
      as.character(mid_strength_beer) == "1" |
      as.character(full_strength_beer) == "1",
      levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
      labels = c("0", "1")
    ),

    wine = factor(
      as.character(white_wine) == "1" |
      as.character(red_wine) == "1" |
      as.character(low_alcohol_wine) == "1" |
      as.character(champagne_sparkling_wine) == "1" |
      as.character(fortified_wine) == "1",
      levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
      labels = c("0", "1")
    ),

    spirits_liqueurs = factor(
      as.character(spirits_rtd) == "1" |
      as.character(liqueurs) == "1" |
      as.character(spirits) == "1",
      levels = c(FALSE, TRUE),
      labels = c("0", "1")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    -low_alcohol_beer,
    -mid_strength_beer,
    -full_strength_beer,
    -white_wine,
    -red_wine,
    -low_alcohol_wine,
    -champagne_sparkling_wine,
    -fortified_wine,
    -spirits_rtd,
    -liqueurs,
    -spirits
  )
```

# Logistic Regression
## Model Specification
```{r}
model_int <- glm(ckd ~ age + alcohol_quantity * sex + alcohol_frequency + diabetes + beer + wine + spirits_liqueurs + cider + cocktails, data = ckd_data, family = binomial)
```

$$
\begin{aligned}
\log\left(\frac{P(CKD_i=1)}{1-(P(CKD_i=1))}\right)
={}& \beta_0 + \beta_1 \mathrm{Age}_i + \beta_2 \mathrm{AlcoholQuantity}_i + \beta_3 \mathrm{Sex}_i \\
&+ \beta_4 (\mathrm{AlcoholQuantity}_i \times \mathrm{Sex}_i) \\
&+ \beta_5 \mathrm{AlcoholFrequency}_i + \beta_6 \mathrm{Diabetes}_i \\
&+ \beta_7 \mathrm{Beer}_i + \beta_8 \mathrm{Wine}_i \\
&+ \beta_9 \mathrm{SpiritsLiqueurs}_i + \beta_{10} \mathrm{Cider}_i+ \beta_{11} \mathrm{Cocktails}_i
\end{aligned}
$$

## Assumptions and Diagnostics
### Linearity in the logit

```{r,echo=FALSE}
plot(
  ckd_data$alcohol_quantity,
  model_int$linear.predictors,
  main = "Alcohol Quantity and the Linear Predictor of CKD",
  xlab = "Alcohol quantity",
  ylab = "Linear predictor (logit)",
  pch = 16,
  col = "gray20",
  cex = 0.5
)

lines(
  lowess(
    ckd_data$alcohol_quantity,
    model_int$linear.predictors
  ),
  col = "steelblue2",
  lwd = 2
)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
plot(
  ckd_data$age,
  model_int$linear.predictors,
  main = "Age and the Linear Predictor of CKD",
  xlab = "Age",
  ylab = "Linear predictor (logit)",
  pch = 16,
  col = "gray20",
  cex = 0.5
)

lines(
  lowess(
    ckd_data$age,

)
```

### Multicollinearity
```{r,message=FALSE,warning=FALSE,echo=FALSE}
round(vif(model_int), 2)
```


```{r}
model_no_int <- glm(ckd ~ age + alcohol_quantity + sex + alcohol_frequency + diabetes + beer + wine + spirits_liqueurs + cider + cocktails, data = ckd_data, family = binomial)
round(vif(model_no_int), 2)
```


### Influential Observations
Influential observations were assessed using Cook's distance.  

```{r,echo=FALSE}
cd <- cooks.distance(model_int)
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
top5 <- order(cd, decreasing = TRUE)[1:5]

plot(
  1:length(cd), cd,
  type = "h",
  col = "gray50",
  lwd = 1.2,
  xlab = "Observation",
  ylab = "Cook's distance",
  main = "Cook's Distance Plot",
  ylim = c(0, max(cd) * 1.15)
)

points(
  top5,
  cd[top5],
  col = "steelblue",
  pch = 16,
  cex = 1
)

text(
  top5,
  cd[top5],
  labels = top5,
  pos = 3,
  col = "steelblue",
  cex = 0.8
)
```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
top7_cd <- sort(cd, decreasing = TRUE)[1:7]
round(top7_cd, 4)
```
Influential observations were assessed using Cook's distance. Several observations had relatively higher Cook's distances, the maximum value was 0.103. 

The observations with higher Cook's distances were examined in more detail.
```{r,echo=FALSE}
top7 <- order(cd, decreasing = TRUE)[1:7]

data.frame(
  Observation = top7,
  Cooks_Distance = round(cd[top7], 4),
  ckd_data[top7, c(
    "ckd",
    "age",
    "alcohol_quantity",
    "sex",
    "alcohol_frequency",
    "diabetes",
    "beer",
    "wine",
    "spirits_liqueurs",
    "cider",
    "cocktails"
  )]
)
```

After reviewing these observations individually, no data errors were identified, and all observations were retained in the analysis.

## Results and Interpretation
```{r, echo=FALSE}
model_summary <- summary(model_int)$coefficients

results_pretty <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(model_summary),

  OR = exp(model_summary[, "Estimate"]),

  `95% CI` = paste0(
    sprintf("%.2f", exp(model_summary[, "Estimate"] -
                         1.96 * model_summary[, "Std. Error"])),
    "–",
    sprintf("%.2f", exp(model_summary[, "Estimate"] +
                         1.96 * model_summary[, "Std. Error"]))
  ),

  `P-value` = ifelse(
    model_summary[, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001,
    "<0.001",
    sprintf("%.3f", model_summary[, "Pr(>|z|)"])
  ),

  check.names = FALSE
)

results_pretty$OR <- sprintf("%.2f", results_pretty$OR)

print(results_pretty, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE}
plot_data <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(model_summary),
  OR = exp(model_summary[, "Estimate"]),
  Lower = exp(model_summary[, "Estimate"] -
                1.96 * model_summary[, "Std. Error"]),
  Upper = exp(model_summary[, "Estimate"] +
                1.96 * model_summary[, "Std. Error"]),
  p_value = model_summary[, "Pr(>|z|)"]
)

plot_data <- subset(plot_data, Variable != "(Intercept)")

ggplot(plot_data,
       aes(x = OR, y = reorder(Variable, OR))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper),
                 height = 0.2, color = "steelblue2") +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "steelblue2") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Association between Covariates and CKD",
    x = "Odds Ratio (95% CI, log scale)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
ggsave("../figures/forest_plot_all.png")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Extract coefficients and covariance matrix
b <- coef(model_int)
V <- vcov(model_int)

# Female: reference group
beta_female <- b["alcohol_quantity"]

se_female <- sqrt(
  V["alcohol_quantity", "alcohol_quantity"]
)

# Male: main effect + interaction effect
beta_male <- b["alcohol_quantity"] +
  b["alcohol_quantity:sexMale"]

se_male <- sqrt(
  V["alcohol_quantity", "alcohol_quantity"] +
  V["alcohol_quantity:sexMale",
    "alcohol_quantity:sexMale"] +
  2 * V["alcohol_quantity",
        "alcohol_quantity:sexMale"]
)

# Create plotting data
plot_interaction <- data.frame(
  Sex = c("Female", "Male"),
  OR = exp(c(beta_female, beta_male)),
  Lower = exp(c(
    beta_female - 1.96 * se_female,
    beta_male - 1.96 * se_male
  )),
  Upper = exp(c(
    beta_female + 1.96 * se_female,
    beta_male + 1.96 * se_male
  ))
)

# Plot
ggplot(plot_interaction,
       aes(x = OR, y = Sex, color = Sex)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey50"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Male" = "steelblue2",
      "Female" = "tomato1"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Association between Alcohol Quantity and CKD by Sex",
    x = "Odds Ratio (95% CI)",
    y = "Sex",
    color = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
ggsave("../figures/forest_plot_sex.png")
```

```{r}
effect_data <- ggpredict(
  model_int,
  terms = c("alcohol_quantity", "sex")
)

# Plot
ggplot(effect_data, aes(x = x, y = predicted,
                        colour = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
              alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Female" = "tomato1",
               "Male" = "steelblue2")
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Female" = "tomato1",
               "Male" = "steelblue2")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Alcohol quantity (standard drinks per week)",
    y = "Predicted probability of CKD",
    colour = "Sex",
    fill = "Sex",
    title = "Interaction Effect of Alcohol Quantity and Sex on CKD"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
ggsave("../figures/effect_plot.png")
```


```{r}
# smoking * sex, model 3 in the report, interaction
model_smoking_interaction <- glm(ckd ~ age + smoker_status * sex + diabetes, data = ckd_data, family = binomial)
summary(model_smoking_interaction)
```

```{r}
# smoking + sex, model 2, additive
model_smoking_additive <- glm(ckd ~ age + smoker_status + sex + diabetes, data = ckd_data, family = binomial)
```

```{r}
# no smoking, model 1, reduced
model_smoking_reduced <- glm(ckd ~ age + sex + diabetes, data = ckd_data, family = binomial)
```

1. Smoking overall association
```{r}
anova(model_smoking_reduced, model_smoking_additive, test = "LRT")
```

2. Whether sex modifies the association
```{r}
anova(model_smoking_additive, model_smoking_interaction, test = "LRT")
```

3. Joint contribution of smoking and interaction
```{r}
anova(model_smoking_reduced, model_smoking_interaction,test = "LRT")
```
